text.p: Chyron Corp said on Friday it will not proceed with its previously announced public offering of common stock due to the current market valuation of the stock.
The company also said that certain existing shareholders will not sell their stock pursuant to previously granted registration rights.
Chyron added that it has sufficient working capital to pursue its current business goals, and may access the capital markets in the future in conjunction with its acquisition strategy.
The stock of Chyron last traded at 6-1/8, near its 52-week low of six. The 52-week high is 19-7/8.
Chyron makes a broad range of equipment, software and systems that facilitate the production and enhance the presentation of live and pre-recorded video, audio and other data.

In December the company said it filed with the SEC for a proposed 7.65 million share, post-split "secondary offering". It said the company would offer 5.25 million shares and certain selling shareholders would offer 2.4 million shares.
The company previously completed a reverse split.
